title: Twelve windows into Odisha: homepage collection
scope: One existing maritime scene and eleven new images, one per approved theme. Earlier coastal options preserved but no longer in the active homepage set.
implementation: Twelve distinct active scene entries in shared homepage data; each has a theme, title and descriptive alt text.
One still image per document load; avoid last displayed artwork when browser storage permits. No automatic carousel.
Responsive WebP variants at 480, 960 and 1440 pixels. Original PNGs preserved in the project collection.
All captions disclose AI-generated imagined scenes. Images do not document real identities, exact monuments, craft instructions or authenticated events.
Standalone local artwork review gallery retained with the twelve originals.
